service.name: Wings of the Knighthood (Mount)
service.longDescription: Recollection on Extreme guards the Wings of the Knighthood — a guaranteed farm until they drop, with Knight Totems piling up along the way.

rewards.text: — guaranteed, no matter how many runs it takes.
